latest.notes: Fixes the 'walk away and it stalls' bug. Root cause (from the on-air log): a live output-device re-apply did a full stop/restart of the running audio engine even when the device hadn't changed, and if Core Audio rejected the device ('set output device failed', code 'nope') the engine restarted on a dead device → silence, no advance. Now the engine resolves the target device first, does nothing if it's unchanged, keeps the current device if the target is unavailable, and restores the previous device if a switch is rejected — the live graph is only ever touched for a genuine, validated device change. Also restores the Rotations filter in the on-air Audio panel (lost in the v0.5.15 rollback). On-air scheduling engine unchanged.
